verdict_a_installed_native_evidence.finding: Owner Profile 8 report records an actual Chrome manager Reload, correct DEV ID/name/version, enabled and pinned state, unpacked source path, and reopened side panel under the owner account. Store 0.2.205 is separately identified, enabled, and pinned. This establishes the reported native reload/install state.
verdict_a_installed_native_evidence.artifact_binding: Normal import/local receipt/provenance agree on commit b8e31fbb2207b2318a4d1cb2972578c94b56710c, run 39640552208, artifact 12365851226, version 0.2.584, tree digest fcf63381e73def118ca91ee94eed5bed48323206f964ef5067e57dacbaacdc6f, and GitHub artifact digest sha256:7666fa80172f74756e02bcec1173db2bf441283f73397e0ef099cd6a57a16e84. CI success and the root rehash/promotion are reported in review context. The native report records loaded path and version but does not itself carry the receipt/tree digest, so byte-level binding of the live loaded directory depends on that import/promotion/rehash chain.
verdict_a_installed_native_evidence.acceptance_scope: No independent UI replay or product behavior evidence is established. The four T43 dismiss observations receive zero product acceptance credit because the primary plus fresh peer batch ended invalid under the resource guard. T43 database no-write remains unverified: its follow-up retained the baseline timestamp and no fresh aggregate was confirmed. No overall health or Store 0.2.577 approval is established.

verdict_b_provenance_resource_budget_cle.resource: The complete 16-entry owner584 journal has no recorded reasons; it shows admission, healthy watches, confirmed browser stop, resourceInvalid=false, exitCode=0, and final decision valid at 2026-10-21T17:23:17.055Z. This establishes resource validity for that run; the actual executor exit is separately reported as still being polled, so no executor-process exit 0 is inferred.
verdict_b_provenance_resource_budget_cle.provenance: Receipt fields identify the development artifact, not Store eligibility: eligibleStore=false and publish_state=not_published. Source provenance names the pushed commit and run; import-status also reports trackedDirty=true, so the exact-pushed-commit claim is supported by the provenance receipt but is not independently proven by clean checkout status. Native report does not include a build tuple digest.
verdict_b_provenance_resource_budget_cle.cleanup: Separate source-dismiss cleanup journal reportedly has 10 entries, valid final decision, and actual process exit 0. The latest owner cleanup evidence reports two Profile 10 guest tabs closed after profile verification. An older source-dismiss-owned-tab-cleanup report instead says the Profile 10 fixture and manager tabs were not closed due to ownership ambiguity; this is a chronology/evidence conflict and the later verified cleanup is needed to supersede it.
verdict_b_provenance_resource_budget_cle.inventory_honesty: Primary and fresh-peer reports correctly preserve invalid/partial status, no acceptance credit, and unverified database no-write. The owner reload report limits itself to identity, reload, source path, enabled/pin state, panel opening, and cleanup.

limits: Review was evidence-only; no independent native UI replay was performed.
The receipts and reports do not establish complete product health, feature behavior, or Store 0.2.577 approval.
The loaded native path is not cryptographically bound inside the owner report to the receipt tree digest; the reported normal import, promotion, and root rehash provide the external binding chain.
T43 database no-write remains unverified, and the earlier cleanup report conflicts with the later reported verified Profile 10 cleanup.
